requirements_to_testpoints.stimulus: With io_2=false, test current below, at and above 7 A and temperature below, at and above 60 C using the disclosed inverse ADC calibrations. Observe status during the 4000–5999 ms display phase; also combine overload and overheat.
requirements_to_testpoints.oracle: Status is 0 when neither strict threshold is exceeded, 1 for overload alone, and 2 whenever overheated without vibration. Fan io_3 is 255.0 only above 60 C and otherwise 0.0. Each sampled input change affects the applicable output on the next control step.
requirements_to_testpoints.requirement_text:
设计一个工业电机运行监测系统，使用电流传感器 A0、温度传感器 LM35（A1）、振动开关 D2、风扇 PWM D5、蜂鸣器 D6、LED D13 和串口。系统实时监测电机负载、温升和振动，给出正常、过载、过热、机械异常四种状态；过热时开启风扇冷却，机械异常时优先报警并输出 fault code。TM1637（CLK=D4，DIO=D5）用于轮流显示电流、温度和状态编号。
Disclosed configurable bench calibration/thresholds: A0 current=ADC*10/1023 amperes; LM35 A1 Celsius=ADC*500/1023 with5V ADC reference. Overload current>7A, overheat>60C; vibration switch active uses the declared electrical input semantics. Status0 normal,1 overload, 2 overheat,3 mechanical fault; mechanical fault has highest priority, then overheat. Fan PWM255 above60C and0 otherwise. Mechanical fault drives audible/LED alarm and Serial fault code3. TM1637 rotates integer current in amperes, integer temperature Celsius, and status code every2s.

requirements_to_testpoints.stimulus: Assert io_2 during normal, overloaded and overheated conditions; hold it true, clear it, and assert it again. Separately start with io_2=true on the first step.
requirements_to_testpoints.oracle: Active vibration selects status 3, commands a continuous 2000 Hz alarm and LED ON, and emits exactly one 'Fault code: 3' line on each entry, including startup entry. Holding vibration does not repeat the report. Clearing vibration silences the alarm and turns the LED OFF. Fan control remains determined independently by temperature.

requirements_to_testpoints.stimulus: Start with io_7=0 and advance actual elapsed deltas through 2000, 4000, 6000 and subsequent cycle boundaries. Include irregular deltas and a delta spanning multiple display slots.
requirements_to_testpoints.oracle: Display io_6 shows floored calibrated current during phase [0,2000), floored calibrated Celsius during [2000,4000), and status during [4000,6000), repeating indefinitely. Boundary crossings preserve residual elapsed time, including skipped slots.

requirements_to_testpoints.stimulus: Within each display slot, vary its selected quantity without advancing into another slot. Include ADC endpoints 0 and 1023, fractional calibrated readings, and all-zero initial inputs.
requirements_to_testpoints.oracle: Selected values refresh on the next control step using floor rounding. ADC endpoints map to 0 and 10 amperes, and 0 and 500 Celsius. Initial zero inputs produce display 0, fan 0.0, tone 0, LED false and no serial report. No startup delay or blocking display wait is introduced.
